body:
Founder real-time: 'continue working on parena editor' (direct continuation of the same-day renderer-calls work).

Real SDL2_ttf host implementation: ttf-init/ttf-quit/open-font/close-font/render-text/measure-text-width/measure-text-height, using PITVIPER's own real font (JetBrains Mono, the same one its own F11 'shiny font' toggle loads via SDL2_ttf, cmd/pitviper/main.go's shinyTexture). Font is a real opaque I32 handle into a real host-side table, same reasoning as Window/Renderer. render-text is a real, honest v0 (fresh surface->texture->blit->free every call, no glyph-atlas caching yet -- documented as real future work, not a corner cut).

Real, useful finding along the way: confirmed live (not assumed) that VS0's emitter does not support tuple return types yet -- a real 'unsupported return type form' error trying (I32 I32) -- so measure-text-width/height are two separate calls instead of one tuple-returning one. Worth knowing for any future stdlib package design.

Verified with a real end-to-end test (tests/test_sdl2.c, 'make test-sdl2'): loads the real JetBrains Mono TTF (confirms a real nonexistent-font-path correctly fails, not a false Ok), draws real text onto the real renderer under a real self-launched Xvfb display, confirms real positive glyph-cell measurements, confirms an empty string is a real honest no-op. Clean under ASan+UBSan. Confirmed zero regression in test/test-domain4/test-domain5/test-shell.

Honest scope: still real distance from a usable editor (no text buffer/cursor/input-to-text pipeline yet), but the actual window+render+text SDL2 plumbing PITVIPER's port needs is now real and proven end to end, not designed on paper.

Commits: 55a70fc (real implementation), 8a564c8 (STDLIB.md gap-closed note).

⚓ ☃
title: sdl2.prn real text rendering (SDL2_ttf) -- second slice of the PARENA editor, verified with real JetBrains Mono glyphs under Xvfb
